cmd = r'''python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u041/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e7f47f1f.py'

def make(h,w,bg, frames):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r0,c0,r1,c1,col in frames:
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1): g[r][c]=col
    return g
# Both demo inputs reconstructed from the displayed frames; expected results fill each frame interior.

for idx,(g,frames) in enumerate([(D1,[(1,3,5,7),(5,11,11,17),(18,3,22,7),(20,15,23,18),(24,10,26,12)]),(D2,[(0,5,3,8),(5,0,11,6),(4,12,9,17),(11,18,13,20),(15,20,20,25),(20,12,23,15)])],1):

    for r0,c0,r1,c1 in frames:

        expected=7 if (ih*iw)%2 else 2
        assert all(out[r][c]==expected for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)), (idx,(r0,c0,r1,c1),expected)
    print(f'demo {idx}: all frame interiors match')
# Exact test input via listed box frames.
T=make(20,29,4,[(1,1,7,7,9),(4,20,11,27,9),(11,1,14,4,5),(12,12,16,16,6)])
# Verify all dimensions and show the model-produced grid for submission.
result=m.transform(T)
print('test_output='+json.dumps(result))
PY'''
r=terminal(cmd, timeout=30)
